protocol.primary_endpoint: paired mean net virtual reward after equal warmup; higher is better
protocol.claim_gate: spike_memory minus symbolic_memory paired mean > 0 and lower 95% t interval > 0 for each task; otherwise no neural superiority claim
protocol.feature_sampling: 16 recorded windows for each of 8 cues plus blank, one fixed sensor seed; vectors replayed with seeded selection. Does not test long recurrent delays or STDP.
protocol.selection: fixed balanced tasks for validation; adaptive live curriculum evaluated separately
protocol.scope: Local software experiment, not independent preregistration or market forecasting

limitations: One fixed sensory circuit seed; world seeds are independent
Measured feature windows are reused, not freshly simulated for every decision
Cue memory is a stored spike representation, not evidence of spontaneous recurrent memory
Reward probabilities and task families are designed; uncertainty is unknown to the learner within that bounded world
No STDP, consciousness, live trading or financial-execution inference
